resources.string: The order of the hieroglyphs is not important. Drop over the trash can to remove.
Show the Splash screen at application launch
Select the color scheme to use
Select the type of transliteration to use
"Shows a series of hieroglyph panels. Drag to change the point of view, pinch to zoom."
Press this button to change the lighting model.
Press this button to pause/resume the rotation.
Press this button to go back to the previous hieroglyph panel and cycle backwards through the hieroglyph panels.
Press this button to advance to the next hieroglyph panel and cycle forwards through the hieroglyph panels.
"Shows a list of pharaohs organized by kingdom and dynasty. Tap a kingdom or dynasty to expand / collapse. Tap a pharaoh's name for more detailed information."
Press this button to search for a pharaoh by name.
Press this button to access the other features of the application.
Shows general information about a pharaoh and their titulary.
Swipe across to show the various types of titulary.
Press this button to locate the pharaoh in the list of kingdoms and dynasties.
Press this button to toggle between showing all cartouches or only principal cartouches.
"Search for a Pharaoh's cartouche by dragging hieroglyphs to the 'drop' area."
"Press this button to order the list of available hieroglyphs either by most frequently occurring or by their Gardiner's list code."
"There is a tutorial accessible from this menu that uses real examples of cartouches to show how it works. Press the 'Tutorial' button to run it now."

A list of all possible hieroglyphs that may appear in cartouches. The first seven black and white ones represent generic types. The remaining are the actual hieroglyphs ordered by the most frequently occurring.
People or gods in any pose, or body parts.
Animals, insects, reptiles or parts of them.
Actual hieroglyphs ordered by the most frequently occurring.
"A list of cartouches that contain the chosen hieroglyphs. Select the one that matches the cartouche that you are trying to identify to obtain the pharaoh's name."
"Press this button to clear the 'drop' area."
Press this button to Undo the last hieroglyph added.
"Press this button to open a separate window, where the available hieroglyphs are organized by their Gardiner's List codes. Selecting a hieroglyph will add it to the 'drop' area."
"Press the 'lock' button to indicate that you're done selecting hieroglyphs (optional). This will reduce the list of cartouches to those containing that exact number of hieroglyphs."
"An Ibis on a standard. We will use the generic 'bird' hieroglyph."
"Lung and windpipe. We will use the generic 'vertical' hieroglyph."
"Three fox skins. This time, let's use the actual hieroglyph (the generic 'animal' hieroglyph would work just as well)."
"A scarab beetle. We will use the generic 'animal' hieroglyph."
"A door bolt. We will use the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph. Note that the order in which hieroglyphs are added is unimportant."
"The sun. We will use the generic 'circle' hieroglyph."
"Head and neck of a jackal. We will use the actual hieroglyph (the generic 'animal' hieroglyph would work just as well)."
"The goddess Maat. We will use the generic 'person' hieroglyph."
"A reed. We will use the generic 'vertical' hieroglyph. Note that the order in which hieroglyphs are added is unimportant."
"A game board and pieces. We will use the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph."
"A ripple of water. We will use the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph."
"A canal. We will use the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph."
"The god Horus. We will use the generic 'person' hieroglyph."
"The god Amun with staff. We will use the generic 'person' hieroglyph."
"A canal. This time, let's use the actual hieroglyph (the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph would work just as well)."
"A feather. We will use the generic 'vertical' hieroglyph (the generic 'bird' hieroglyph would work just as well)."
"Three fox skins. We will use the generic 'wildcard' hieroglyph. Note that the order in which hieroglyphs are added is unimportant."
"A feather. We will use the generic 'vertical' hieroglyph (the generic 'bird' hieroglyph would work just as well)."
"A door bolt. We will use the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph."
"A door bolt. We will use the generic 'horizontal' hieroglyph."

"This tutorial will walk you through the steps in order to identify a pharaoh by selecting hieroglyphs to reproduce a cartouche. If you haven't already done so, go through the 'Help' before continuing with the tutorial."
You can use generic hieroglyphs (see Help for details) or the actual hieroglyphs or any combination of both.
"This tutorial will repeat with a different cartouche. Press 'GOT IT' to exit at any time."
"As all the hieroglyphs have been added, pressing the 'lock' button will reduce the list of cartouches to those containing that exact number of hieroglyphs."
Shows a list of the cartouches that match. Choose the one that matches the cartouche you are searching for in order to identify the pharaoh.
"Shows a list of available hieroglyphs. Tapping one will add it to the 'drop' area."
"Press this button to show all available hieroglyphs in Gardiner's list code order."
"Press this button to only show 'horizontally' shaped hieroglyphs from those available."
"Press this button to only show 'vertically' shaped hieroglyphs from those available."
"Press this button to only show 'circular' shaped hieroglyphs from those available."

If a hieroglyph has been incorrectly identified, you can delete it by dropping it in the trashcan which will appear as soon as you start dragging the hieroglyph. The remaining hieroglyphs can then be added in any order.
